title: Book on Zorn's Etchings Arrives in a Month
content: A month from now,Dover Publishing will release a bookon the etchings of Anders Zorn (1860-1920), for which I wrote an introductory essay.It's 128 pages, softcover, 8.2 x 10.9 inches. You can pre-order now on Amazon:Anders Zorn: 101 Etchings, edited by James Gurney
